draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.50, the 252nd-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 36th of 37 at CB. He went 166th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (252nd): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (16th percentile), vertical jump (12th percentile). College production: 1 passes defended in 2020, 29th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2025. 47 career games and 5 starts over 4 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2025 against a career-best 2 in 2021. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (2nd percentile). Played 2 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-5 cornerback who played: 5.9% season snap share against a median of 33.5%, below the norm.
